Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single high-resolution blank spell-card FRAME for a collectible album. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE board, not the requested final layout.
Create ONE large isolated BASIC frame in the style shown by the LEFT large card in the reference. Redraw it at high clarity with exquisite individual pen strokes and restrained surface craftsmanship; do not return the comparison board, do not merely crop it. Requested square 2048x2048 canvas if supported. One card centered, fully visible, generous 7% external margin.
Geometry is mandatory: the card OUTER silhouette is a nearly square rectangle width:height exactly 52:56, with four small clipped corners (corner cut about7% of width). Not a tall tarot card. No notch, no hexagon for this particular BASIC sample. Dark brown #483729 outer rim. Keep border narrow enough that at least75% of card area is clean open paper for future artwork. Rich detail resides at rim and corners.
Interior opaque pale WARM GRAY paper with only very subtle vertical shading: #E5DCC9 top to #DDD3BE middle to #D4C7AD bottom. Reduce yellow/ochre cast compared with reference. Fine paper fibers are extremely faint and do not create mottled stains or noisy texture over the central illustration area. No radial vignette, no center glow. Central face completely blank, no spell artwork, no type, no numbers.
Outside the card must be genuine transparent alpha. Do NOT draw a gray checkerboard, solid backdrop, surface, cast shadow, plate, album page, or background. No labels, title, watermarks, logos, hanging decorations.
Match THIS precise frame treatment: Frame style A: hand-cut parchment edged by a confident expressive dark sepia ink contour. A finely drawn uneven inner keyline, tiny dry nib scratches and sparse crosshatching restricted to corners, subtle deckled fiber material within a disciplined silhouette. It should feel crafted by a meticulous eccentric field naturalist, like a treasured original pen-and-ink book illustration. Rich line quality, gentle irregularity, tiny controlled corner folds. No metal, no gems, no dangling objects, no decorative motifs outside the silhouette. Keep the large open face and clear frame profile. This is the most classic understated storybook option.
Reserve the lower-right corner for later mechanism badge overlap: do not add any badge or empty circle there. This is a candidate source illustration, not a screenshot. Very sharp fine edge definition, handmade gothic survival storybook aesthetic, not glossy 3D.
